note: Real export shipments are documented, not merely claimed: India -> Russia (MOUILA port), air cargo from Delhi, with dates (2025-11-29, 2026-02-23), HS codes and B/L numbers (3595742, 9921388). Buyer of record is a Russian counterparty ("TO THE ORDER OF", consignee listed as MNPK AVIS LAJF SAJNS, Khimki/Moscow). Declared HS 901890 is broadly consistent with the observed 90189029/90189099 lines, but the same B/L also carries HS 30061020 (Spongostan/Surgicel haemostats), so the company ships mixed surgical consumables, not a single HS line. Industry claim "IT и электроника" is contradicted by the shipment record — goods are surgical/laparoscopic and haemostatic products; treat the industry field as wrong, not the company. Domestic (India) supply evidence is absent from public sources in this pass — not a negative finding, just unverified; GST turnover and export value remain null.
